raw_text:
Payments Product Manager at Precoro Inc.
Location: Remote Worldwide (Anywhere).
About Precoro:
Precoro is an innovative AI-powered procurement centralization and automation platform serving 1,000+ customers in 80+ countries.
What you'll do:
- Own the Payments product area end-to-end from discovery through delivery, launch, and iteration.
- Create and maintain integrations with payment providers, PSPs, gateways, and banking partners.
- Navigate partner limitations, versioning, error handling, reconciliation, and automated payout flows.
- Coordinate across Engineering, CS, and external payment partners to keep the product ready for new payment methods.
- Define and track success metrics, writing SQL queries and building KPI dashboards.
What we look for:
- 3-5+ years as a Product Manager with hands-on experience building or scaling payment integrations (routing, PSP/acquirer integrations, virtual cards, ACH, or cross-border payments).
- Strong ability to work with APIs, webhooks, and technical integrations.
- Experience writing SQL queries or using BI tools for data-driven decisions.
